panels.description: Per-user throughput over the dashboard time range: node_exporter counters of each session's tun interface joined on(device) with ocserv_session_info. Unlike the journal panels, it does not wait for disconnect.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (server, username) ((rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{instance="$node"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{instance="$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * 8 * on (device) group_left (server, username) group by (device, server, username) (topk by (device) (1, ocserv_session_info{server=~"$server",username=~"$username",device!=""}))))

panels.title: Traffic by User (Live)

panels.description: Throughput over the last ~2 minutes, independent of the dashboard time range: rx+tx of the session's tun interface (node_exporter), joined with the user via device.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (server, username, device) ((rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{instance="$node"}[2m]) + rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{instance="$node"}[2m])) * 8 * on (device) group_left (server, username) group by (device, server, username) (topk by (device) (1, ocserv_session_info{server=~"$server",username=~"$username",device!=""}))))

panels.title: Top Users Now

targets.expr: sum by (server) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{instance="$node"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (device) group_left (server) group by (device, server) (topk by (device) (1, ocserv_session_info{server=~"$server",device!=""}))) * 8

sum by (server) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{instance="$node"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (device) group_left (server) group by (device, server) (topk by (device) (1, ocserv_session_info{server=~"$server",device!=""}))) * 8

panels.title: Server Traffic (Live, TX ↑ / RX ↓)
panels.description: Per-instance throughput: node_exporter counters of the session tun interfaces summed by server. TX is towards clients (download), RX from clients. occtl server RX/TX only grows at disconnect, so it is not used here.

Bytes per user over the dashboard time range, including sessions still open: interface rates are joined with the user every 5 minutes and summed, so reconnects and interface changes do not matter (within ~1% of total tun traffic). Data starts with the device label (ocserv_exporter v1.2.0); ranges longer than ~340 days exceed the subquery point limit.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum_over_time((sum by (server, username) ((rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{instance="$node"}[5m]) + rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{instance="$node"}[5m])) * on (device) group_left (server, username) group by (device, server, username) (topk by (device) (1, ocserv_session_info{server=~"$server",username=~"$username",device!=""}))))[$__range:5m]) * 300)

Traffic (finished sessions)
panels.description: Bytes of sessions that ended in the range. Counted when a session ends, so open sessions are missing and the bytes land at disconnect time. Before ocserv_exporter v1.2.2 every exporter restart re-counted the replayed journal, so ranges spanning such restarts are inflated. For volume per user use Traffic Volume by User.

targets.expr: sum by (username) (increase(ocserv_received_bytes_total{server=~"$server",username=~"$username"}[$__interval]) + increase(ocserv_sent_bytes_total{server=~"$server",username=~"$username"}[$__interval])) and on (username) topk(10, sum by (username) (increase(ocserv_received_bytes_total{server=~"$server",username=~"$username"}[$__range]) + increase(ocserv_sent_bytes_total{server=~"$server",username=~"$username"}[$__range])))
